claims.head: Power against power
claims.call: The Predators’ L1 (Forsberg, O'Reilly and Stamkos) spends at least 62% of its 5-on-5 time against the Islanders’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Predators keep sending Forsberg’s line (Forsberg, O'Reilly and Stamkos) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Andrew Brunette has been choosing strength on strength. Tonight the Islanders’ first line is Holmström, Horvat and Palmieri.

claims.gist: At home, Andrew Brunette likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Islanders’ first line.

notes.text: Mathew Barzal is on the injured non-roster list (knee injury) and has not played this season. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
Matias Maccelli is out 4-6 weeks (lower body injury) and has missed the last 2 games.
Mitchell Chaffee was added to the roster on Oct 20 and has played beside Casey Cizikas and Kyle MacLean.
Kyle Palmieri is no longer killing penalties: 0% of the team’s shorthanded time in 10 games, down from 37% last season.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 9 games cover only 33% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the 9th-lowest in the league (a typical team: 43%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Mavrik Bourque returned in their last game after missing 4 games. Their recent numbers were built mostly without him.
Jayden Struble joined from MTL on Oct 10 and has played beside Nicolas Hague.

NSH.head: The Predators start a half-step ahead
NSH.body: The Islanders will be without Barzal, while Nashville has home-ice advantage. The Islanders have been out-chancing opponents lately, though. The Islanders can still swing it if they keep shots to a minimum.

NYI.head: A slightly uphill night for the Islanders
NYI.body: The Islanders will be without Barzal, while Nashville has home-ice advantage. The Islanders have been out-chancing opponents lately, though. The Islanders’ best way to tip it is keeping shots to a minimum.
